result.message: The router cannot provide weather information. It handles only the network and cannot search the internet or give weather updates.

records.section: What iGate cannot do yet | cannot do, not supported, restart the router, turn on the lights, smart home, weather, news, search the internet, make a call, conditional command
records.text: iGate handles the router's network only. It cannot yet: control lights, plugs or smart-home devices; restart the router by voice; give weather, news or search the Internet; place calls or make a phone ring; take conditional commands such as "if he is still gaming tonight, block him" (the router does not watch for that condition: give the command when you want it, or name a time to schedule it). For a request outside its abilities, iGate says so instead of guessing.

records.section: Wi-Fi security modes: WPA3, WPA2, open | wpa3, wpa2, wifi encryption, wifi security, network without password, open network, sae, psk, mixed
records.text: WPA3 (SAE) is the safest mode today and is required on 6 GHz. WPA2 is still acceptable with a strong password. Mixed WPA2/WPA3 mode lets older devices connect. An open network (no password) lets anyone nearby join and see unencrypted traffic; use it only on purpose, for example a time-limited guest network.
